description:
Parse and resolve every user-supplied issue-id argument once in the CLI entry point, before any executor call.

## Background

`main.rs` passes raw issue-id arguments from `cli.rs` to executor methods, which resolve them internally through `resolve_issue_id`. Internal callers such as template application and batch creation already hold full ids. `main.rs` holds 88 production issue-id references and truncates short ids with a literal length at `main.rs:3369,3769`. The short-hash tests at `crates/jit/tests/fast_issue/short_hash_tests.rs:156-220` drive executor methods with prefixes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each plain issue-id argument that `main.rs` passes to the executor is parsed once into `IssueIdPrefix` and resolved once to `IssueId` before the call.
- [hard] REQ-02: `cli.rs` argument structs keep raw strings only for values `main.rs` parses, and no other module parses a CLI issue-id argument.
- [hard] REQ-03: Too-short prefixes report the invalid-prefix error, and other malformed or unknown ids keep the not-found error class and exit code 3.
- [hard] REQ-04: Short ids rendered by `main.rs` come only from `short_id()`, and no site there truncates an id by length.
- [hard] REQ-05: Tests that exercise short-prefix input exercise it through the CLI entry point or the resolver, not through executor methods.
- [hard] REQ-06: `main.rs` holds no interim call-site parse: each issue-id argument is parsed exactly once, at the boundary.
title: The CLI resolves each issue-id argument once at entry
